title: WorldModelCompression-MPC: Activation-Aware SVD Truncation & Operator Distillation for Fast Model-Predictive Control
description: WorldModelCompression-MPC is an applied reinforcement learning and planning package developed by the Computational Genomics & Agentic Systems (CGAS) Lab at Northwestern University. It provides Activation-Aware Singular Value Decomposition (ASVD) spectral truncation and Hybrid Forward-KL + Elite distillation of latent world models, accelerating Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) planning rollouts by 1.72x while retaining >96% of uncompressed policy reward.
